meta.title: Shotsy Alternative — Bring Your GLP-1 History
meta.description: Moving off Shotsy? Dozify reads the export, shows every record before it writes one, and names any column it did not recognise. Free, on your device.

strings: Coming from Shotsy? Bring the history with you
Export from Shotsy, open it in Dozify, and see every record that is about to be written before one of them is. Free, and the file never leaves your phone.
The columns Dozify looks for in a Shotsy export

Dozify is a tracking tool, not a medical device. It does not recommend doses and does not provide medical advice.
